records.tagline: Movement breaks that fit your actual schedule
records.description: Movement breaks that fit in the gaps. Built for the 9-to-5 reality. A Chrome extension for office workers that reads your schedule or Google calendar, finds gaps between meetings, and gives neck/back/posture sessions requiring little time and no equipment. Movement, posture, recovery — timed to your actual day, not a generic schedule.

records.name: Smart Linker
records.tagline: AI-powered internal linking plugin for WordPress
records.description: Автоматична контекстна перелінковка для WordPress. Покращте SEO, залучайте відвідувачів глибше в контент. AI пропозиції, перевірка битих посилань, статистика. Підходить для контентних сайтів, блогів та інтернет-магазинів.

records.name: scoutAI.site
records.tagline: Humanizing Hiring - Removing Noise
records.description: Nobody trusts the job market anymore — ghost jobs, AI résumé spam, applications into the void. Both sides are broken. ScoutAI rebuilds the trust. Every job gets a 16-signal Reality Score that flags ghosts and fakes (63,797 roles scored, 7,330 verified live). You see the roles that are real and what a recruiter actually reads in your résumé in 6 seconds — then apply with proof. Free to start, no signup. I am working on the employer side as well. ATS systems operate on a 30 year old broken promise

records.name: Stripe.Directory
records.tagline: New way for you & agents to search for businesses on Stripe
records.description: Stripe Directory is a single discovery layer for developers and AI agents to find businesses on Stripe—including Stripe Apps, Projects.dev providers, and mpp.dev services—and integrate them without the need to manually search for them.

records.name: Tuberflix
records.tagline: Discover curated short films & web series on YouTube
records.description: Tuberflix helps viewers discover quality short films, web series, documentaries, and independent content available on YouTube.

records.name: ExamGuard Online
records.tagline: Private, local-first online exams — no webcam proctoring
records.description: Run secure online exams for laptop classrooms. Build an exam, share one link, auto-grade and review — with private in-browser proctoring. Free for your first 2 exams, no student install, no webcam.

records.name: Orbit
records.tagline: Collaborative AI wiki, stored in SharePoint
records.description: Orbit is a collaborative workspace for your team's notes, documentation, and wikis. Everything is stored as plain files in your organisation's OneDrive and SharePoint, under the access controls your IT team already manages.

records.name: AffiliScan
records.tagline: Stop losing commissions on broken Amazon affiliate links
records.description: AffiliScan is a free Chrome extension that scans YouTube video descriptions for broken, unavailable, and available Amazon affiliate links. YouTubers lose commissions every day without knowing their links are dead. AffiliScan finds them instantly so you can fix them before losing more money. Supports bulk playlist scanning, dashboard with scheduled daily/weekly scans, find replacement for broken and unavailable products, and email alerts when issues are found.

records.name: Seedance 2.5
records.tagline: Seedance 2.5 AI Video Generator | Text & Image to Video
records.description: Seedance 2.5 AI video generator for cinematic 4K videos, 30s single-shot output, multimodal references, character consistency, and camera motion control.

records.name: Echo Health Scan
records.tagline: 100% Offline-First Health Records. Zero Cloud, Zero Tracking
records.description: Most health apps prioritize data harvesting, storing your sensitive medical records on cloud servers vulnerable to breaches. Echo Health Scan is different. It is a 100% offline-first medical records manager that puts you in total control. • Zero-Cloud: Your data stays on your device—period. • Privacy-First: No logins, no tracking, no data selling. • Local Storage: Secure, instant access to prescriptions and lab reports, even without internet. Your health data belongs to you, not a server.

records.name: Postpronto
records.tagline: Make any image post-ready for every platform ⭐
records.description: Postpronto turns any photo or screenshot into a polished, perfectly-sized post for Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, Pinterest & more. Add a background and frame, crop/zoom, and export every platform size at once. 100% in your browser — no uploads, no signup — and built for mobile.

records.name: Mindstone Rebel
records.tagline: AI workspace for agents that know your work and ask first
records.description: Rebel is a desktop AI workspace for agentic work. It connects your memory, meetings, files, actions, automations, and tools so AI agents can help with real work — while keeping sensitive actions behind approval checks. Built Fair Source, with portable workflows and model choice.

records.name: ToolPorto — Honest AI Tool Reviews
records.tagline: Hands-on AI tool reviews. No marketing fluff.
records.description: Most AI tool review sites just rewrite press releases and paste affiliate links. ToolPorto is different: every single review is based on hands-on testing. I sign up for each tool, run real tasks, and compare alternatives side-by-side on the same benchmarks before publishing anything.

records.name: Nimt
records.tagline: Your AI Search Coworker in Slack
records.description: Nimt lives in Slack and handles AI search for you, end to end. It's not a tool, not a dashboard. Nimt is your AI search coworker. It sets up tracking across every major AI model, builds your dashboard, and does the work to make you win, on-page and off-page. Nimt even works in your CMS, your inbox, social media, and 3,000 other.

records.name: React UI Kit V7
records.tagline: All the chat components you need. None of the complexity
records.description: Build chat, voice, and video experiences in React faster with CometChat React UI Kit V7. Get production-ready messaging components, calling, AI features, theming, localization, and customization out of the box. New in V7: a more flexible component architecture, plugin-based extensibility, improved customization, and support for React, Next.js, React Router, and Astro. Ship a fully featured chat experience effortlessy.

records.name: Customer Relationship Agents by Clarify
records.tagline: The M in CRM shouldn't be you
records.description: Agents that handle the CRM work you've been doing manually — pipeline digests, lead enrichment, data hygiene, call coaching, and much more. They run on a schedule or a signal, work across your stack, and fire without you touching them. Set them to run fully autonomously or require your approval before acting. Describe what you want to automate or start from a template. Clarify builds it from there.

records.name: Prospector by Synter
records.tagline: Your outbound agent, right inside Slack
records.description: Nobody likes dashboards. So we built Prospector instead — an outbound agent that lives in Slack. Just ask: How are my campaigns doing? Who engaged with this post and is worth reaching out to? It reads your outbound, builds lists from real engagement, and answers in a sentence. Prospector runs outbound, Synter runs paid media, and they share the same audiences. Try it: /prospector /pipeline /campaigns /contacts /report

records.name: StaleMate PR
records.tagline: Your menu bar turns red when PRs pile up
records.description: StaleMate is a tiny macOS menu-bar app that watches your GitHub & GitLab pull requests. The icon stays green when the queue is clean, fades yellow when reviews build up, and goes red when things start to rot. Up to 5 independent monitors. Native, sandboxed, $-friendly.

records.name: Riska
records.tagline: Bilingual wildfire alerts and guidance for Portugal
records.description: Riska turns official and satellite data into clear wildfire alerts, daily risk, and bilingual prepare/recover guides for everyone in Portugal — residents, newcomers and firefighters. Every fact shows its source and time. Free for safety. PT + EN.

records.name: Swimio
records.tagline: AI swim coach with Apple Watch tracking & smart workouts
records.description: Swimio combines AI coaching, advanced Apple Watch swim tracking, and personalized workout generation in one platform built specifically for swimmers. Create workouts tailored to your goals, follow them directly from your Apple Watch, track pace, SWOLF, stroke efficiency and heart rate, and get actionable performance insights after every session. Built for swimmers, coaches and teams who want more than a simple lap counter.

records.name: E2 Studio
records.tagline: Free E-2 investor visa eligibility check and guides
records.description: E2 Studio helps E-2 investor visa applicants prepare on their own. Start with a free eligibility check that scores your profile in minutes, then read in-depth guides on requirements, investment, source of funds, and business plans. A self-help tool, not a law firm.

records.name: Lunch Walk
records.tagline: A photo diary for your lunch walk. No streaks, no login.
records.description: Lunch Walk is a photo diary for one thing: a short walk at lunch. Two taps. Snap what is around you with the rear camera, tag it with one sense word, done. No selfies, the idea is to look outward. What is different: no calendar, no streaks, no stats to chase, no account, no server. Everything stays on your phone, location data stripped on save, no analytics, no ads. A skipped day is not a broken streak, it just is not there. Free, with an optional tip. iOS and Android.

records.name: EMTA
records.tagline: Jobs for Freshers ' Internship and Training Academy
records.description: Looking for the best job consultancy and placement services in Indore? EMTA offers expert career guidance, jobs for freshers, and recruitment solutions.

records.name: AI Finance Tools
records.tagline: Independent directory of AI-powered finance tools
records.description: AI Finance Tools is an independent directory of AI-powered finance tools — bookkeeping, expense management, payroll, tax, and more. Each tool is scored on accuracy, speed, ease of use, pricing, and compliance using our published methodology.

records.name: kithly
records.tagline: Stop carrying your household in your head.
records.description: Manage groceries, meals, chores, appointments, bills, and family schedules in one place so one person doesn't have to remember everything.

records.name: Vibe and Go - Automated QA
records.tagline: Automated QA testing for no-code creators
records.description: Your app works perfectly on your MacBook. But 60% of your users are on different devices—Android, older phones, slow connections— and you have NO IDEA if your app works for them. Vibe and Go tests your app on 12 real devices in 2 min. No code, no installation, no $10k QA team. Just paste your URL and catch bugs BEFORE your users do. 100+ creators are already using it. First 100 get 50% lifetime discount.

records.name: LE VERE
records.tagline: What you own, fully known.
records.description: A secure place to document, value, and protect your personal items. Including the stories behind them. OCR capture, documentation, live valuation, and severe weather alerts. Visible Ownership™ for everything you own. Two weeks free, then subscription plans.

records.name: CheckMyVIN
records.tagline: Free AI vehicle reports — Carfax alternative with MCP
records.description: Free AI VIN decoder for any US-titled vehicle. Paste a VIN, get a printable report in ~30s: specs, open NHTSA safety recalls, maintenance data (oil, tires, fluids), and an AI buying summary with a 1–10 score. What's different: it handles EVs correctly (battery info, not oil specs), never invents data it doesn't have, and ships an MCP server so Claude can decode VINs in-chat. Free embeddable widget too. Built on free official government data.

records.name: Stablecoin Ramp Radar
records.tagline: crypto, fiat
records.description: Compare USDT and USDC on/off-ramp routes by net received amount, fees, KYC, limits, speed, source confidence and risk.

records.name: Seedream 5.0 Pro
records.tagline: Seedream 5.0 Pro
records.description: Create realistic AI images, cinematic artwork, typography posters, and marketing visuals from text prompts with Seedream 5.0 Pro online. Try it now.

records.name: RoamUpload
records.tagline: Upload IPA to App Store Connect from any browser
records.description: Stop installing Xcode just to upload an IPA. RoamUpload is the fastest way to publish iOS apps to App Store Connect directly from your browser. No Mac. No Transporter. No complicated setup. Upload your IPA, connect your App Store Connect API Key, and release your app in minutes.

records.name: Senswit
records.tagline: AI-Native Decision Intelligence OS
records.description: SensWit is the AI-native Decision Intelligence OS that turns signals into smarter growth decisions.

records.name: Grecify
records.tagline: Track Expenses, Subscriptions, Split Bills & Discover Deals
records.description: Grecify helps families, friends, roommates, and small groups manage their financial lives in one place. Track expenses, split shared bills, organize receipts, store gift cards, and save with deals and coupons. Whether you're planning a trip, managing household expenses, or keeping track of everyday spending, Grecify makes it easier to stay organized, settle balances, and discover savings opportunities without juggling multiple apps.
